V_CHECKPOINT_WEAKENING: Shortens mitosis, inhibits spindle-checkpoint kinases (for example AURKB, PLK1, TTK/MPS1, CENPE) or is a microtubule poison offered as rescue; worsens an already weakened checkpoint.
V_NO_APPROVED_PRODUCT: No approved single-ingredient product acts on the node; only tool compounds, supplements or unapproved agents exist.
V_PEDIATRIC_TISSUE_HARM: Plausible harm to growth, kidney, bone marrow, muscle or hearing in a child who already has growth failure or organ involvement.
V_CHEMO_INTERACTION: Conflicts with anticipated cancer therapy: CYP3A4 clash with vincristine, overlapping marrow or kidney toxicity, or a documented adverse reaction to a standard-regimen agent.
V_DIRECTION_UNCERTAIN: Could lower or degrade the causal protein, or the direction of effect on its function is unestablished or confounded.
V_NOT_APPROVED: Investigational, withdrawn or unverified approval status; approval is not backed by a regulatory source.
V_TRANSCRIPT_FATE_UNRESOLVED: Strategy needs a transcript or protein the evidence says is destroyed (for example readthrough when the transcript is NMD-competent) or whose fate is unmeasured.
